extension.description: Starlight brings smoked glass, warm gold focus, and Manrope type to Kodi. Home presents a library board and a shared hub rail.
extension.news:
v2.0.2 Show text in add-on dialogs such as the Plex Skip intro button and Up Next.
v2.0.1 Add a Stop button to the video and music player controls. Hide the seek bar when you leave fullscreen playback.
v2.0.0 Starlight rebuilt from scratch: a Plex-first Home with hubs, Search and Discover, 26 library views, new player, music, cast and Live TV screens, Starlight settings, and the event horizon artwork. Requires the Starlight helper.
